name: Evergreen Nagashaft
description: Hold two guard lines at once with the shaft so high and low are each held by one half of the stance.

name: Granite Nagablade
description: Slice the foe's lead arm and bring the edge straight back to slice it again on the return.

name: Ruinous Tsubaring
description: Thrust the point down one lane then flick it to the neighbouring lane before the foe can answer.

name: Murk Ishizukibase
description: Take two cuts in turn on the upper and lower shaft and pass both outward.

name: Uchiotoshi Ruin
description: Cast a sweep and a trailing second sweep in one turn with qi fed to each in sequence.

name: Corroding Nagatip
description: Step along one lane and cut then change lanes mid-cut so the blade lands from the new side.

name: Kakenerve
description: Weave the shaft over and under the foe's weapon twice until the two are bound in a cross.

name: Mightishi
description: Reap the foe's front and back lines at once with two arcs thrown from a single hip turn.

name: Kakevalor
description: Lock both of the foe's arms between the shaft and blade while a field of qi holds them in place.

name: Punishing Habakiring
description: Gather the whole qi field in the shaft and cast a double sweep that cuts every foe in the court.

name: Flintlike Ishizuki
description: Rest the shaft over the lead shoulder like a folded wing and watch the foe's chest.

name: Ironnagi
description: Cut with the outer length of the curve like the long feather of a wing across the throat line.

name: Wrathful Bladecurve
description: Peck the very point into a seam in the armor with one short snapping thrust.

name: Adamantine Habakiring
description: Sweep the blade wide in front like an opening wing and clear a thrust from the line.

name: Mightkake
description: Rise on the toes and bound forward on a lifting step as though on a warm updraft.

name: Ishizukibase Vitality
description: Lift the gaze and let the shaft feel the field of motion around the body at once.

name: Tempered Sukui
description: Circle the foe in a long arc and cut the moment his guard turns to follow.

name: Thorn Kake
description: Hook the tip behind the foe's knee and drag the leg out in a tight talon pull.

name: Strangling Mawashi
description: Whirl the blade in a showy ring to draw the foe's eyes then cut from the opposite side.

name: Sanguine Tsubaring
description: Drop a large pale crescent of cutting qi from high above onto the foe's raised guard.

name: Gust Nagashaft
description: Send two sweeps out one after the other like hawks hunting from the same height.

name: Unseen Glint Nagablade
description: Vanish from the guard and reappear above the foe with the blade already falling in a diving cut.

name: Hoarfrost Sayacap
description: Set two shallow curves of the shaft before the body so each blow meets one and slides to the other.

name: Tempered Mawashi
description: Slice down one side of a dish-shaped arc and up the other to cut the same foe twice.

name: Titanic Uchiotoshi
description: Thrust at the wrist then at the elbow along the rim of the foe's guard in two quick drives.

name: Fastening Sayacap
description: Sweep the blade under the foe's weapon and lock it against his body with a held curve.

name: Nagi Whirlpool
description: Take two steps on mirrored arcs so the blade is always on the foe's open side.

name: Vengeful Nagaheel
description: Cut at the lowest point of the dish with a heavy pulse of qi that drives deep into the thigh.

name: Downpour Nagatip
description: Cast two dish-shaped arcs of qi edge that cross at the middle and reap all they enclose.

name: Bladecurve Valor
description: Hold a still surface of qi along the shaft and send any blow back at the one who struck.

name: Ishizuki Wrath
description: Sweep under the foe's whole stance with qi-heavy edge and tip the ground itself out from under him.

name: Bladecurve Obduracy
description: Stand with the blade pointing downstream of the foe and the shaft flowing from shoulder to hip.

name: Tempered Nagaheel
description: Slice along the line of the foe's flank like water cutting a bank over many seasons.

name: Lunging Harai
description: Cross the gap in two long strides and thrust the point at the throat on arrival.

name: Nagamettle
description: Flick the shaft outward to break a blow into a spray of small glancing contacts.

name: Granite Nagi
description: Hop from one planted foot to the next in a chain of short bounds with the blade level.

name: Nagiscourge
description: Follow the direction of the foe's own motion and sweep into the side he is already turning toward.

name: Thorn Sukui
description: Hook low and pull toward the wielder so the foe's feet are dragged out as by an undertow.

name: Ironishi
description: Rush into a tight cluster of foes and cut twice in quick turbulent arcs.

name: Rumble Tsubaring
description: Pour the whole weight and a heavy stream of qi down in one thundering overhead cut.

name: Thorn Habakiring
description: Sink the butt cap into the ground and let qi flow along the shaft as a bed under flowing water.

name: Lacerating Kake
description: Pour out the stored qi in a flood-wide arc that sweeps every foe in the open field off their feet.

name: Sunemettle
description: Rest the shaft on two parallel lines of guard so either may be taken up without a pause.

name: Hellish Mawashi
description: Cut along the left track from shoulder to hip in a clean unhurried diagonal.

name: Mangling Sayacap
description: Cut along the right track from hip to shoulder as the answering half of the pair.

name: Nova Nagi
description: Thrust where the two tracks cross so the point lands on the centre line of the foe.

name: Siltkake
description: Slide from one footing line to the next in a single smooth shift of the hips.

name: Sanguine Uchiotoshi
description: Run two qi currents down the shaft in turn and sweep with the second as the first expires.

name: Harai Valor
description: Beat the foe's blade twice along parallel lines so the weapon rattles loose from his grip.

name: Indomitable Nagatip
description: Hold the guard on a locked track and let qi keep it from yielding to blows.

name: Blaze Ishizuki
description: Switch from the left track to the right in the middle of a slice so the cut changes line.

name: Nagablade Wrath
description: Chase a retreating foe with one cut on each track in a run of alternating strokes.

name: Mightharai
description: Cross two heavy arcs like rails over the foe's body so no guard can block both.

name: Nagivalor
description: Pin the foe's weapon along one track with the shaft and seal the other track with the blade.

name: Blistering Nagaheel
description: Blink along one track past the foe and cut him from behind along the other.

name: Hoarfrost Bladecurve
description: Turn the shaft slowly in a circle before the body so the wheel is always ready to speed up.

name: Shattering Sukui
description: Cut with the outermost curve of the blade as the rim of a turning wheel.

name: Nova Ishizukibase
description: Thrust from the hub of the stance straight out like a single spoke at the foe's chest.

name: Nagaspine
description: Roll the shaft over the foe's weapon so it climbs the wheel and falls off behind the shoulder.

name: Tempered Harai
description: Turn the entire body a half circle behind the blade and sweep with the speed of the turn.

name: Tempered Ishizukibase
description: Spin the shaft end around the rim of the turn and crack it into the foe's ribs.

name: Torrent Sukui
description: Pivot around one planted foot as the hub and carry the blade around the foe on the rim.

name: Sukuihavoc
description: Spin a huge wheel of qi edge around the body that reaps every foe within the circle.

name: Rumblenaga
description: Catch the foe's weapon in the turning wheel and wrench it out of his hands.

name: Uchiotoshi Havoc
description: Keep the great wheel turning so the sweep reaps all near and the turn itself guards the wielder.

name: Nagadurance
description: Stand with the blade on one shoulder and the shaft end on the other like a pair of hawks perched.

name: Tempered Habakiring
description: Cut a slim crescent from high to low in the swoop of a hunting bird.

name: Nagawrath
description: Jab twice with blade tip and butt cap like the beaks of two hawks at one prey.

name: Nagavalor
description: Fold the shaft against the body at the instant of contact and let the blow slide past the wing.

name: Gustkake
description: Glide forward on two matching footfalls like hawks wheeling side by side.

name: Hellish Kake
description: Cut from above and below at once with two edges of the stance so the foe is rent between.

name: Thorn Nagashaft
description: Snare the foe's weapon in the crook of the blade and hold it under steady qi.

name: Iron Nagashaft
description: Hang a moment on the toes then fall onto the foe with the blade in one heavy stroke.

name: Devastating Kake
description: Throw two crescents up and over a guard so both fall on the foe's shoulders together.

name: Nagatip Ruin
description: Chase the foe with a run of low wing-like sweeps that keep him from setting his feet.

name: Rumblesukui
description: Blink beside the foe and let two crescents fall from the same blade onto one target.

name: Facet Tsubaring
description: Stand square to the wind with the blade raised and the shaft held steady against its push.

name: Rumble Ishizuki
description: Cut in the rush of a gust so the edge arrives with the wind behind it.

name: Rumble Mawashi
description: Thrust straight along the chosen bearing with no turn of the wrist from start to end.

name: Murknaga
description: Let the shaft ride the wind over the shoulder and carry a cut off to the rear.

name: Unseen Sayacap
description: Pace across open ground in long even strides with the blade tip never dropping.

name: Granite Harai
description: Sweep the longest arc the shaft allows with the wind of the oath filling the edge.

name: Chime Tsubaring
description: Stand still with the haft light in the hands and read the wind and the foe's weight shift.

name: Hoarfrost Nagablade
description: Hook the foe's weapon and hold it fast with the steady strength of a sworn word.

name: Ironkake
description: Break the foe's formation with one hard gust of qi that rides the length of the edge.

name: Hour Uchiotoshi
description: Press forward along the sworn bearing with the shaft held low so the foe is driven back step by step.

name: Ferocious Blaze Mawashi
description: Raise the blade to the sky and cast a vast arc of wind-driven qi edge that reaps the field below.

name: Unassailable Habakiring
description: Stand firm on the high ground and sink the shaft into a guard that has sworn not to yield.

name: Mightnaga
description: Slice the edge across the foe's guard as the words of the oath are spoken.

name: Iron Nagablade
description: Thrust down from a raised stance to catch the foe below in the throat or the shoulder.

name: Inexorable Nagaheel
description: Bar the way with the shaft held crosswise and let qi make it as firm as a kept promise.

name: Mightsune
description: Run across flat ground at speed and cut the foe as the blade passes his flank.

name: Harnessing Nagi
description: Pin the foe's lead foot to the ground with the blade point and break his step.

name: Blaze Harai
description: Load the sweep with the full weight of the oath and cut through guards that would stop a lesser blow.

name: Hoarfrost Nagaheel
description: Hold the line at the brink of the plateau so no foe can pass the shaft.

name: Ishizuki Ruin
description: Speak the oath complete and release one unbound sweep that cuts across the entire plateau front.

name: Unrelenting Nagashaft
description: Hold the blade steady on an open bearing so that no direction is closed to the shaft.

name: Rumblesune
description: Cut in a high clean arc under open sky with no thought of the ground behind.

name: Pressing Nagatip
description: Thrust and hold the point on the foe's centre until he gives ground.

name: Murk Sayacap
description: Open the rear hand and let the shaft float so a blow glances off without a clash.

name: Ghosting Sukui
description: Take a long step straight along the heading to keep the foe in front of the blade.

name: Kakewrath
description: Sweep through the open arc on the bearing with qi that never leaves the line.

name: Strangling Ishizuki
description: Beat the foe's blade off its heading so that his next stroke has no line.

name: Aegis Ishizukibase
description: Spin the shaft in an open ring that guards without ever being closed against the wielder's own cuts.

name: Sunewrath
description: Drift sideways on the wind and slash at the foe who has lost track of the bearing.

name: Tempered Bladecurve
description: Reap along the heading with one long heavy stroke that carries qi to the farthest tip.

name: Ponderous Nagi
description: Hold the bearing and press the foe's weapon down until his arms cannot rise.

name: Kakescourge
description: Blink down the bearing in one gust and rend the foe as the wind catches up.

name: Facetishi
description: Stand with the back to open air and the blade held forward so every threat is faced.

name: Gust Nagablade
description: Slice at the foe's unguarded side as the edge sweeps out from behind the shoulder.

name: Nagaheel Scourge
description: Thrust the point far out under the open sky to reach a foe who thought himself clear.

name: Sunespine
description: Free one hand from the shaft and slap a blow away while the other hand holds the blade.

name: Kake Ruin
description: Sweep the blade along the skyline of the foe's raised guard and cut the top arm.

name: Impervious Sayacap
description: Turn the shaft in the open so a chasing weapon is carried wide of the body.

name: Rumble Ishizukibase
description: Roam in a loose arc around the foe and cut whenever the blade comes to bear.

name: Granite Habakiring
description: Cast a sweep with no set limit so the qi edge carries as far as the open ground allows.

name: Equipoise Nagatip
description: Turn the back to the wind and let its push carry the shaft through a counter that throws the foe aside.

name: Ironharai
description: Hold nothing back and sweep through the foe's line in one heavy arc that carries on past the target.

name: Charter Nagashaft
description: Stand with the shaft held at its full length and the blade edge angled into the wind.

name: Gustsukui
description: Slice at the far end of the arc where the edge is fastest and the foe expects no touch.

name: Corroding Tsubaring
description: Slide the grip to the butt and thrust the point out to the limit of the whole weapon.

name: Impervious Habakiring
description: Whip the haft across in a gale-quick parry that flicks the foe's weapon away.

name: Ghosting Bladecurve
description: Lunge forward off the rear foot to add a full pace to the reach of the blade.

name: Might Uchiotoshi
description: Sweep with a gale of qi along the edge so the cut seems to arrive before the swing.

name: Thornishi
description: Hook the foe's weapon at full reach and drag it toward the wielder's side.

name: Iron Sayacap
description: Keep the foe at the tip of the blade with a long guard that never lets him close.

name: Sanguine Nagi
description: Draw the edge back across the foe's body with a gale of qi that deepens the wound.

name: Nagaheel Ruin
description: Swing at the very end of the shaft so the heaviest part of the stroke lands past guard range.

name: Glint Ishizuki
description: Drive the point through a seam of armor with gale-fed qi concentrated in its sharpest part.

name: Overbearing Harai
description: Pin the foe's weapon to the earth at full reach and hold it there with the shaft.

name: Rampaging Gust Nagatip
description: Flash across the whole field in a single breath and cut the foe at the far edge of sight.

name: Flintlike Nagablade
description: Hold a deep stance in which the shaft is pledged to one line and will not leave it.

name: Sunescourge
description: Slice once and follow through to the end of the arc as the oath requires.

name: Facetnaga
description: Jab the point at the foe's chest in the instant the vow is spoken aloud.

name: Unassailable Ishizukibase
description: Parry with the whole length of the shaft and keep the foe's blade pressed against the wood.

name: Lightning Kake
description: Step to a marked spot on the ground and plant the foot as a witness would.

name: Lacerating Harai
description: Sweep once with qi that the wielder has promised to spend in full on this stroke.

name: Enthralling Tsubaring
description: Bind the foe's weapon to the shaft and keep it bound until the oath is paid.

name: Iron Mawashi
description: Press the cut home with the weight of the oath and drive the edge deeper than a plain stroke.

name: Sukuiscourge
description: Complete the oath in one reaping stroke that cuts through whatever stands in its line.

name: Thornnaga
description: Hold the shaft before the body in a guard that stays as steady as a vow kept.

name: Blaze Kake
description: Cast the final sweep the oath demands and cut every foe the wielder has sworn to answer.

name: Flintlike Habakiring
description: Hold the shaft along the line of the wind so that each gust is split by the blade.

name: Blaze Sukui
description: Slice along the wind's line so the cut carries on past the point of contact.

name: Nova Sukui
description: Thrust along the line and let the wind add its push to the point.

name: Iron Bladecurve
description: Sweep across the line with qi riding the gust and the edge cutting at the crest.

name: Ishiwrath
description: Step across the wind's line and cut as the blade crosses the foe's shoulder.

name: Chime Sayacap
description: Rest the haft on the wind and feel where the foe stands by the way the line bends.

name: Rumble Nagashaft
description: Reap along the wind's line with a stroke whose qi grows as it travels the length of the edge.

name: Unconquered Nagablade
description: Wheel the blade along the line to catch each blow on the wind and turn it from the body.

name: Merciless Uchiotoshi Wrath
description: Burst along the wind's line in a flash and cut the foe as the gust arrives at his side.
